title: Contractor Contact Windows for Real Estate Service Contract Requests
content:
Under the Real Estate Service Contracts plans, the assigned contractor contacts the customer within a set number of hours, which depends on the plan and on whether the request is routine or an emergency.

## Contact window schedule (hours)

| Plan | Routine request | Emergency request |
|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Closing Starter | 48 | 24 |
| Bridgewell Closing Standard | 48 | 24 |
| Bridgewell Closing Plus | 48 | 24 |
| Bridgewell Closing Premier | 24 | 12 |
| Bridgewell Closing Premier Two-Year | 24 | 12 |
| Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year | 48 | 24 |

## Points of reading

- The Bridgewell Closing Premier and Bridgewell Closing Premier Two-Year plans carry the shorter windows: 24 hours routine and 12 hours emergency.
- On the other four plans the windows are 48 hours routine and 24 hours emergency.
- A window is a number of hours within which the assigned contractor contacts the customer; for a hypothetical emergency request on the Bridgewell Closing Plus plan, that is 24 hours, and for a routine request on the same plan, 48 hours.
